tasks.gr8-creative-writing-project-t3: Topic: Creative writing project. Cover research, planning, drafting, peer review, revision, redrafting, presentation, and audience awareness. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify process-writing stages, choose effective revision decisions, evaluate project structure, and reflect on improvement from feedback.
tasks.gr8-short-stories-narrative-technique-t3: Topic: Short stories and narrative technique. Cover narrator viewpoint, sequencing, conflict, climax, and characterisation. Ask Grade 8 learners to analyse narrative structure, interpret viewpoint effects, infer character motivation from evidence, and explain how sequencing shapes meaning.
tasks.gr8-essay-writing-style-t3: Topic: Essay writing and style. Cover narrative and reflective essay forms, introductions, paragraph coherence, descriptive detail, sentence variety, and stylistic devices. Ask Grade 8 learners to choose strong structural options, recognise effective language choices, and edit essays for clarity, coherence, and impact.
tasks.gr8-letter-to-the-press-t3: Topic: Writing a Letter to the Press. Cover reacting to an article, the layout of a letter to the editor (addresses, date, Dear Editor, heading, body, Yours faithfully), giving reasons and facts, linking words, a polite persuasive tone and a clear request. Ask Grade 8 learners to place a part, choose the right closing, or pick the most polite and persuasive sentence.
